actions.desc: The parzz'val makes three attacks: one with its oversized maw and two with its oversized fists.
actions.desc_ru: Мультиатака. Существо совершает 3 атаки: одну — атака «Оверсизед Мав»; две — атака «Оверсизед Фисц».
actions.name: Multiattack

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
actions.desc_ru: Атака оружием ближнего боя: +8 к попаданию, досягаемость 10 фт., одна цель. Попадание: 10 (2к4+5) дробящего урона.
actions.name: Oversized Fist

actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 4 (2d8) acid damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the parzz'val. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the parzz'val, and it takes 18 (4d8) acid damage at the start of each of the parzz'val's turns. A parzz'val can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If the parzz'val takes 15 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the parzz'val must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the parzz'val. If the parzz'val dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Oversized Maw

traits.desc:
As a bonus action, the parzz’val can spit a sticky, acidic web in a 20-foot cube. The web must be placed wholly within 60 feet of the parzz’val and must be anchored between two solid masses or layered across a floor, wall, or ceiling. A web layered over a flat surface has a depth of 5 feet. The web is difficult terrain and lightly obscures the area.

A creature that starts its turn in the web or enters the web during its turn must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

The web persists for 1 minute before collapsing. The parzz’val is immune to the effects of its web and the webs of other parzz’vals.

traits.name: Caustic Web (Recharge 5-6)

traits.desc: If the parzz’val deals damage to a creature with three melee attacks in one round, it has advantage on all melee attacks it makes against that creature in the next round.

traits.desc: The parzz’val regains 10 hp at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hp.

ru.description: Крупная аберрация, мировоззрение: хаотично-злое. Класс доспеха: 14 (природный доспех). Хиты: 115 (11к10+55). Скорость: ходьба 50 фт.. Характеристики: СИЛ 21, ЛОВ 16, ТЕЛ 20, ИНТ 5, МУД 10, ХАР 7. Уязвимость к урону: звуком. Сопротивление урону: дробящего, колющего, рубящего. Иммунитет к урону: кислотой. Иммунитет к состояниям: ослепление, очарование, бессознательное состояние. Чувства: слепое зрение 120 фт., пассивное Восприятие 10. Показатель опасности: 8. Структурированные механики записи: особенностей: 3, действий: 3.
ru.name: Парзз'вал
